title: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure initiation

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to modify an existing PDU session. The SMF creates and sends a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message to the UE.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to UE to initiate network-requested PDU session modification. Contains various IEs based on modification requirements.

entities.name: Authorized QoS rules
entities.description: IE containing authorized QoS rules for the PDU session. Included when QoS rules are modified or need synchronization.

entities.name: Authorized QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: IE containing authorized QoS flow descriptions. Included when QoS flow descriptions are modified or new QoS flows are created.

entities.name: Selected Session-AMBR
entities.description: IE containing the session-AMBR value. Included when session-AMBR is modified.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure transaction identity IE. Set to PTI from UE request or 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'.

entities.name: RQ timer
entities.description: IE containing reflective QoS timer value. Included when reflective QoS is supported.

entities.name: Always-on PDU session indication
entities.description: IE indicating whether PDU session should be always-on. Values: 'Always-on PDU session required' or 'Always-on PDU session not allowed'.

entities.name: Received MBS container
entities.description: IE containing MBS session information including TMGI, MBS decision, security container, and service area details.

entities.name: T3591
entities.description: Timer started by SMF when sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND. Stopped upon receiving response from UE.

entities.name: Triggered by UE-requested procedure
entities.description: Condition where network-requested modification is triggered by a preceding UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: QoS rules modified
entities.description: Property indicating authorized QoS rules of the PDU session have been modified or marked for synchronization.

entities.name: Session-AMBR modified
entities.description: Property indicating session-AMBR of the PDU session has been modified.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message
Message contains Authorized QoS rules IE when QoS rules are modified
Message contains Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE when QoS flows are modified
Message contains Selected Session-AMBR IE when session-AMBR is modified
Message contains PTI IE set based on triggering condition
Message contains RQ timer IE when reflective QoS is supported
Message contains Always-on PDU session indication IE based on network policy
Message contains Received MBS container IE for MBS session management
Procedure starts timer T3591 when sending modification command
QoS rules modification establishes inclusion of Authorized QoS rules IE
Session-AMBR modification establishes inclusion of Selected Session-AMBR IE
UE-requested trigger condition guards PTI IE value assignment
